title: The Ten Chariots of Descent
description: When divine truth shines forth from the Lord's inmost, it does not arrive bare. It descends by being clothed, degree after degree, in ten vessels fitted to the soul's reception: the doctrinal carriage, the dwelling of the Divine Human with its tabernacle, the path of regeneration, the call going out as garment, the answer that returns, the living medium, breath given to perception, wisdom shining as wisdom, truth in the natural degree, and divine love — the living fire mingled in all the rest. Through these ten the Lord walks through every form of the soul, those interior and outermost, those above in the rational and those below in the natural. Having put them all on as his clothing, he comes, and at last is unveiled — the same one who descended through every fitting form.
